methodologyNotes: Twelve refractometers were verified 2026-08-12 directly against manufacturer/brand-store product pages (Atago USA, Hanna Instruments, MISCO, Milwaukee Instruments' EU distributor site, VEE GEE Scientific, REED Instruments, Sper Scientific Direct, Extech); the seed "VeeGee STX-3" is not present in VEE GEE's current live catalog (confirmed via full-text site search returning no STX-3 match) and was replaced with the brand's current directly-analogous digital model (MDX-101) plus its current analog handheld Brix model (BX-1) to keep VEE GEE represented; fields not stated on the fetched page (sample volume, prism material, resolution/accuracy on sparser listings, and Milwaukee's USD price, which is only published in EUR on its EU site) are left null rather than guessed or converted.
